Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d

Class IconRecipe.Builder

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d.IconRecipe.Builder
Enclosing class:
IconRecipe
public static final class IconRecipe.Builder extends Object
A fluent builder for IconRecipe. Numeric fields default to "no change" (tintAmount 1, brightness/contrast 0, cornerRadius 0, rotation 0) and nullable fields to null, so an untouched builder renders the plain glyph.
